recurring_shares_amount.name: recurring_shares_amount
recurring_shares_amount.value: ("recurring_shares"."kind" = 'vast' AND "recurring_shares"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "recurring_shares"."basis_points" IS NULL) OR ("recurring_shares"."kind" = 'percentage' AND "recurring_shares"."basis_points" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "recurring_shares"."amount_cents" IS NULL)

recurring_shares_months.name: recurring_shares_months
recurring_shares_months.value: "recurring_shares"."start_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND ("recurring_shares"."end_month" IS NULL OR ("recurring_shares"."end_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND "recurring_shares"."end_month" >= "recurring_shares"."start_month"))
